imports.moneyConflict: Columns castka, mena and polozky: the currency differs from the stored order. No amounts or currency were filled. Verify the source currency and import again.
imports.incompleteMoney: Columns castka, mena and polozky: a stored amount has no currency. A new currency cannot safely be assigned to an old amount. Verify the original monetary data.

csv.invalidTime: Column {{column}}: enter a valid date or time with at most three fractional second digits. Times without an offset use Europe/Prague.
csv.unterminatedQuote: Row {{row}}, column {{column}}: missing closing quote. Correct the CSV and import it again.
csv.surplusCells: Row {{row}}: extra values follow the last column {{column}}. Correct the delimiters or quotes.
csv.duplicateHeader: Row 1, column {{column}} appears more than once (including aliases). Keep it only once.
csv.invalidText: Row {{row}}, column {{column}}: text must contain 1 to 200 characters.
csv.invalidLine: Column polozky, item {{item}}: check the name and SKU (at most 200 characters), decimal quantity and amount.
